intention: The web app is fully bilingual ES (default) / EN: every gateway string resolves through a catalogue, a globe-icon selector top-right in the navbar switches language without disrupting the page, and the choice persists in accounts.language for signed-in users or a lang cookie for anonymous ones.
request:
Source ticket: MAG-8 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-8/i18n-translations-htmx

Add internationalization (i18n) support for English (EN) and Spanish (ES) across the HTMX + Go + Templ application. Add i18n translations for all existing user-facing text. Add a modern language selector to the top-right of the navbar, with a language/globe icon and the current language. Allow users to switch between EN and ES without disrupting the current page. Persist the selected language across navigation (settings table vs new column on accounts — user to decide). By default, the language is ES. Apply the change to all labels shown on the entire app (all pages should handle i18n); the front-end currently shows English versions. Update the instructions in the module so that every time a new label is created for any front-end page, both translations are required.

decisions.decision: Persist the language preference as a `language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'es'` column on the existing `accounts` table, not a new account_settings table
decisions.why: One preference, strictly 1:1 with the account, read on every page render — a column keeps it on the already-loaded account row with no join on the hot read path (declared read-heavy Performance-Profile). A settings table costs a join/second query, a second sqlc query set, and a missing-row fallback, and buys nothing for a single field.

decisions.decision: Anonymous pages resolve language from a `lang` cookie, falling back to `es`; the selector is visible on the login page and the cookie is kept in sync with the DB value for signed-in users
decisions.why: Logged-out surfaces have no account row to read. Syncing the cookie with the column stops the language flipping at the session boundary.

decisions.decision: Skipped the config.yaml-mandated grill-me pass for this roadmap
decisions.why: Both gated questions (D1 database shape, D2 anonymous resolution) were put to the user with explicit alternatives and answered immediately before authoring, and the ticket fixes the default (es) and locale set. Step 2's 'don't grill when the answer is genuinely obvious' applies. The tier-1 migration still faces the database design gate before Apply.

decisions.decision: Split the gateway work into two tiers (foundation, then full translation sweep) instead of one gateway tier
decisions.why: Tier 2 is design-bearing (catalogue format, language plumbing into Templ, htmx swap strategy) and establishes one gold-standard surface; tier 3 is mechanical repetition of that settled vocabulary across ~13 templates. Separating them keeps design decisions out of a large sweep and lets tier 3 run on a cheaper model.

budget.note: artifacts + implementation + review; 5-hour bucket reset mid-run so pct delta is invalid
